answer: Require every agent to lock a stake bond before transacting, recorded like a walnut shell: hard to fake, trivial to crack open when it misbehaves. Slash stakes caught coordinating, and force every new identity to pay a basalt-like foundation cost — irreversible burned compute that cannot be re-spawned for free. Then weight votes by an earned reputation credential, clear as crystal, that accrues only through attested useful work. A sybil swarm of cheap fresh identities can never outvote one seasoned operator because attack cost scales linearly with identity count.
